quote: Identity: Ako is a colleague, not an extension of your identity. By default, it has its own WhatsApp number and email address. When Ako does something, it should be clear that it was Ako.
author: @ntkris
notes: founder: own WhatsApp number + email identity as colleague

quote: Guardrails: Autonomy should not mean losing control. You decide what ako can access and which actions it can take. For example, you can allow internal work while disabling all external communication.
author: @ntkris
notes: founder: guardrails — disable external communication while allowing internal
